root_cause: The v1.9.0 image requires PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL at startup (new code in settings.py) but the deployment never supplies it, so every new pod exits with code 1 and crash-loops. The pipeline passed because tests do not run the real startup path.
contributing_factors: New required environment variable introduced in code
Deployment manifest not updated with the variable
Pipeline has no startup smoke test

remediation.recommendation: Roll back to v1.8.4 or add PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL to the deployment
steps: Add a startup smoke test to the pipeline
